verdict.rationale: First-party docs say skills trigger automatically from task context. A session-start bootstrap injects context telling the agent it has skills, and the using-superpowers skill orders it to invoke relevant skills before any response or action. Activation is also engineered and tested: the writing-skills method pressure-tests skills against baseline agent behavior until agents comply, and an evals harness checks skill compliance on real Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how skill description text is written to drive correct selection, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the right skill fires at the right moment (the author's blog hedges that Claude only 'should' default into planning).
